2607.02303.title: A Hippocampus for Linear Attention: An Exact Memory for What the Recurrent State Forgets
2607.02303.paper_summary: Linear-attention and state-space language models compress the prefix into a fixed-size recurrent state, yielding O(1) memory at the cost of a lossy exact memory: when many key--value associations compete, earlier facts are overwritten and needle recall degrades. Inspired by Complementary Learning Systems, we give linear attention a hippocampal complement. HOLA (Hippocampal Linear Attention) keeps the usual delta-rule state as a compressive memory and adds a bounded exact KV cache, forming a semiparametric test-time memory: the state models linearly compressible structure, while the cache stores associations that should not be forced through that state. The cache writes without a learned eviction module, keeping tokens with large beta * ||e||, the prediction residual actually committed to the state; a decoupled RMSNorm-gamma cache read then turns these exact KV pairs into sharp retrieval rather than soft averaging. At 340M parameters trained on 15B SlimPajama tokens, HOLA lowers Wikitext perplexity from 27.32 to 22.92 (-16.1%), below a full-attention Transformer++ (26.88), and improves LAMBADA perplexity from 30.95 to 30.26. It also achieves the best linear in-context retrieval and remains much more robust than GDN or a matched HOLA+recency cache on RULER needle-in-a-haystack recall out to 32k tokens (16x its training length).
2607.02303.paper_summary_zh: 線性注意力和狀態空間語言模型將前綴壓縮為固定大小的遞歸狀態，實現 O(1) 的記憶體，但代價是損失精確記憶：當許多鍵值關聯競爭時，早期事實會被覆蓋，導致回憶能力下降。受到互補學習系統的啟發，我們為線性注意力提供了海馬體的補充。HOLA（海馬體線性注意力）將通常的增量規則狀態作為壓縮記憶，並添加了一個有界的精確 KV 緩存，形成了一個半參數的測試時記憶：狀態模型呈線性可壓縮結構，而緩存則存儲不應強制通過該狀態的關聯。緩存在沒有學習驅逐模塊的情況下進行寫入，保留具有大 beta * ||e|| 的標記，即實際提交給狀態的預測殘差；然後，解耦的 RMSNorm-gamma 緩存讀取將這些精確的 KV 對轉變為尖銳的檢索，而不是軟平均。在 340M 參數上，訓練於 15B SlimPajama 標記，HOLA 將 Wikitext 的困惑度從 27.32 降至 22.92（-16.1%），低於全注意力的 Transformer++（26.88），並改善 LAMBADA 的困惑度從 30.95 降至 30.26。它還實現了最佳的線性上下文檢索，並在 RULER 的針對大海捞针的回憶中，比 GDN 或匹配的 HOLA+最近緩存更具穩健性，延伸至 32k 標記（是其訓練長度的 16 倍）。
